newsitem.title: USA: Loctite says urges patience on Henkel bid.
newsitem.headline: Loctite says urges patience on Henkel bid.

text.p: Loctite Corp said on Wednesday its shareholders should wait for a special panel's recommendation on Henkel KGaA's bid for all outstanding shares of Loctite common stock.
The adhesives company said in a statement that the special panel of its board of directors was reviewing the bid.
It urged stockholders not to accept or reject Henkel's offer until the panel completed its review and announced its recommendation.

Henkel's wholly owned subsidiary HC Investments Inc has increased its offer for the 65 percent stake it does not already own in Loctite to $57.75 a share. The offer increase values the whole of Loctite at $1.2 billion.
Henkel is a Dusseldorf, Germany-based consumer products group. Loctite's stock opened up one to 58-7/8.
